description: Development safeguards and verification for Orchestrator Harness.

hooks.command: uv run --project "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/dev" --locked python "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py" session-start
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r=(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); $input | uv run --project (Join-Path $r '.codex/dev') --locked python (Join-Path $r '.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py') session-start"

hooks.command: uv run --project "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/dev" --locked python "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py" guard-dangerous
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r=(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); $input | uv run --project (Join-Path $r '.codex/dev') --locked python (Join-Path $r '.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py') guard-dangerous"

hooks.command: uv run --project "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/dev" --locked python "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py" pre-compact
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r=(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); $input | uv run --project (Join-Path $r '.codex/dev') --locked python (Join-Path $r '.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py') pre-compact"

hooks.command: uv run --project "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/dev" --locked python "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/scripts/hook_runner.py" verify-on-stop
